result.reviewScopeSummary: Initial verification for Story 6 covered the SDK and CLI delete surfaces, projection tombstone writes, drop-vs-clear cascade behavior, deleted-read filters, TC-6.x coverage, and configured gates. No blocking findings were found.

verified: AC-6.1/TC-6.1: test/mutations-delete.test.ts:177-203 deletes m3, verifies message reads and turn membership exclude it, and event read-back is unchanged; read filters are in messages/internal/store.ts:217-225 and turns/internal/store.ts:77-95.

AC-6.2/TC-6.2: test/mutations-delete.test.ts:206-279 verifies deleted message forms are removed, turn/chunk-1 forms are pending and queued, chunk 2 is unchanged, and recomposition inputs exclude the deleted message; cascade implementation is in messages/internal/cascade.ts:120-214.

AC-6.3/TC-6.3: test/mutations-delete.test.ts:282-300 verifies prompt delete refusal code message_initiates_turn, turn id/path in reason, and unchanged snapshot; deleteMessage check is in messages/index.ts:528-536.

AC-6.4/TC-6.4: test/mutations-delete.test.ts:303-345 verifies turn delete removes turn/messages from reads and chunk membership while events remain; deleteTurn implementation is in turns/index.ts:416-466.

AC-6.5/TC-6.5: test/mutations-delete.test.ts:348-416 verifies chunk summaries rebuild from remaining member projections, chunk 2 forms are unchanged, and raw boundaries remain identical; chunk-member composition filter is in turns/internal/forms.ts:117-127.

AC-6.6/TC-6.6: test/mutations-delete.test.ts:419-472 verifies empty chunk summary rows are dropped, not failed, no rebuild remains queued, and reads/drain succeed; empty-chunk cascade branch is in messages/internal/cascade.ts:225-251.

AC-6.7/TC-6.7: test/mutations-delete.test.ts:475-575 verifies open-target, missing-id, double-delete, and live-row turn-delete cases with stable refusal codes and unchanged snapshots; filtered validation reads are in messages/internal/store.ts:65-96 and turns/internal/store.ts:46-55.
AC-6.8/TC-6.8: test/cli-process-mutations-delete.test.ts:126-207 verifies spawned CLI parity for message delete, turn delete, and refusal behavior; CLI dispatch is in cli/index.ts:317-390.

additionalObservations: TC-6.1-TC-6.7 live in test/mutations-delete.test.ts and TC-6.8 lives in test/cli-process-mutations-delete.test.ts rather than the test-plan's older file targets; the new files are recorded in test/red-manifest.json and green-verify's immutability check passed.
Production-path audit found no material fake adapter, shim, placeholder, or non-real delete behavior in runtime code; the deterministic provider double is confined to tests.
